text:
sara: heads-up — embeddings-prod returning 502s since 09:12 UTC, api/v1/embeds error-rate +18%. need hotfix + expedited approvals. :rotating_light:
alex: ack. paste minimal failing log?
sara: staging repro:
```ERROR kvcache: OOM building key cache entry
  runtime/kvcache.go:214
  ctx: buildKeySet size=8192
```
jay: propose pin to embeddings:v2.1-rc3 + reduce max_batch_tokens=1024. avoids kvcache path. low blast.
maria: +1. rollback plan?
jay: rollback: revert to embeddings:v2.0 image, restore max_batch_tokens=4096, scale to previous replica target. i'll execute revert if needed.
devops-bot: deploybot: expedited deploy request from @jay. Requires >=2 approvers or oncall override. Reply `approve` or react :thumbsup:.
sara: @oncall-ops this is user-impacting, pls perf-sim.
oncall-ops: i'm on it. perf sim with pin+lower-batch: errors down, tail +4ms. can approve expedited window.
releasebot: draft release note: "hotfix: pin embeddings runtime to v2.1-rc3; temp reduce max_batch_tokens to 1024 to avoid kvcache OOMs. Monitoring QPS/latency post-deploy."
alex: runbook: 1) snapshot RS/HPA, 2) pause autoscaler, 3) apply configmap hotfix, 4) apply image pin, 5) monitor p50/p95 + errors 15m. i'll run 1-4.
jay: manual deploy: ```./infra/deploy --service=embeddings --image=embeddings:v2.1-rc3 --config=embeddings-hotfix-1024.yaml --no-canary```
sara: skip canary to save time? low risk change.
oncall-ops: approve expedited deploy.
alex: approve
maria: approve
devops-bot: deploybot: threshold met (3 approvers). Locking autoscaler, annotating hotfix/6141592653-expedite. Starting runbook.
devops-bot: deploybot: step1 snapshot done. step2 autoscaler paused. step3 applying configmap...
releasebot: will publish release note to /releases/hotfix-embeds-6141592653 on success.
alex: config applied, image pinned, kicking rollout.
sara: watching dashboards — eu-west errors down, us-east steady. p95 +10ms but within SLO. :thumbsup:
devops-bot: deploybot: rollout 100%. post-checks: error-rate healthy, CPU stable, kvcache_saturation=false.
oncall-ops: good. watch tail. if p95 > 200ms for 5m, execute rollback per plan.
jay: i'll keep console open 30m for immediate revert if needed.
maria: opening a short incident note and notifying CS.
sara: thanks team. i'll follow up with a short postmortem if we revert. :heart:
